Welcome to Adamstown Community College, a hub of educational excellence proudly under the patronage of the DDLETB. As a leading community college, we embody the five core values of Excellence in Education, Care, Equality, Community, and Respect.
In 2022, we completed the FUSE anti-bullying programme and were invited to a national event, hosted at the head office of Meta. When it comes to bullying, we recognise, we respond and we report.

Green-Schools is Ireland's leading environmental management and award programme. In 2023, we were awarded Ireland’s Cycling school of the year. We also have Green Flags for our work in Litter and Waste, Water and Travel and are in our first year of our Biodiversity flag.
